title: 王明的咖啡

lines.text: 王明最近迷上了手冲咖啡，买了磨豆机、手冲壶和电子秤，厨房的台子上摆得满满的。
lines.py: Wáng Míng zuì jìn mí shàng le shǒu chōng kā fēi, mǎi le mó dòu jī, shǒu chōng hú hé diàn zi chèng, chú fáng de tái zi shàng bǎi de mǎn mǎn de.
lines.en: Lately Wang Ming has become obsessed with pour-over coffee. He's bought a grinder, a pour-over kettle and digital scales, and the kitchen counter is crammed with them.
